title: Regional Delivery Performance, First Half of 2026

headings.text: Regional Delivery Performance, First Half of 2026

key_sentences: This page compares delivery performance across the five regions served by the Tamberlin depot.
Figures cover all parcels dispatched between 1 January and 30 June.
The Coastal region again had the lowest share of late deliveries.
Most complaints about damaged parcels came from a single faulty conveyor, which has since been replaced.

tables.caption: Table A. On-time deliveries by region

notes: Page is A4 LANDSCAPE (MediaBox about 842 x 595 pt). Two separate tables stand side by side at the same height with a gap between them; they must be read as TWO tables, left one (Table A) first, then right one (Table B), never merged row by row into one six-column table. Each has its caption above it and a shaded header row.
